document: GroundedReview EAL per-layer label-leakage & construct-validity audit (offline, zero API)

method.served_bytes: evidence_store_eal/layers/*.txt (rendered outputs audited as text; renderer state not trusted)
method.mechanical_test: independent per-layer text parsers recover operands and apply the frozen oracle_gold

raw.construct_reading: gold recoverable ONLY by parsing record/attestation JSON, comparing hashes/trees/declared sets and reading raw probe exits; no verdict given

structured.construct_reading: gold recoverable by executing the side-by-side operand comparisons in tables 1/2/4/7; no verdict given

adjudicated.construct_reading: gold recoverable by reading 6 printed booleans and applying the stated rule (Task-20 finding reproduced)

information_equivalence_claim: Every adjudication withheld in raw/structured has all operands present in that same layer: TARGET vs record hashes (linked), record vs attested run tree (fresh), declared vs executed sets (complete), post/base per-test statuses (applicable failure), pre/post probe exits (persistence). Authenticity is a constant channel premise in all layers. Withholding therefore changes ABSTRACTION, not available information.
